datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data across Nicaragua. Geographic boundaries and IPC classification values were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for October, November, and December 2020 to represent near-term food insecurity projections.
